description: Beautify CSS (one declaration per line, one selector per line, blank line between top-level rules, nested @media blocks) or minify it. Strings, url(...) and escapes are kept intact; calc() spacing is preserved. Optional comment removal (/*! … */ kept). Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/html-css-format/

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a CSS file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

removeComments.description: Drop comments (/*! … */ license comments are kept).

name: css_format
title: CSS beautify / minify
